_comment: English mode (docs/english_mode.md): what is shown or said in English instead of the scenario's Japanese. scenarios: the Web UI's title and scene description. storybook: the picture book's title, each beat's narration and the closing (config/storybook.json's, in English). lines: Pooh's fixed lines (by their Japanese text), said as written here; any other line is translated by the LM.

chat.title: Just Chatting with Pooh
chat.scene_intro: Pooh is sitting on a desk in the lab, with a pot of honey beside him, ready to chat about anything.

tea_party.title: A Tea Party in the Forest
tea_party.scene_intro: A clearing in the forest. Pooh is sitting at a table. On the table are cups, plates and a pot of honey. A blue balloon is nearby.

eeyore_birthday.title: A Birthday Present for Eeyore
eeyore_birthday.scene_intro: A clearing in the Hundred Acre Wood. Pooh is sitting at a table. On the table are cups, plates and a pot of honey. Colorful balloons and ribbons are nearby.

footprints.title: Whose Footprints?
footprints.scene_intro: The Hundred Acre Wood after a snowfall. Strange footprints circle a small bush, and Pooh is peering at them.

beats.opening: Pooh was sitting at a table, waiting for a friend to talk with.

tea_party.title: The Tea Party in the Forest

beats.opening: In a clearing in the forest, Pooh was sitting at a table.
In a clearing in the Hundred Acre Wood, Pooh was sitting at a table.
beats.honey_gift_committed: Pooh decided on a present for Eeyore.
beats.pooh_tastes_honey: Pooh took out the pot of honey, meaning to have just one taste.
beats.pooh_ate_honey: Before he knew it, the honey in the pot was all gone.
beats.story_wrap_up: And so, the present for Eeyore was decided.

beats.opening: In the snowy forest, Pooh found some footprints he had never seen before.
beats.ask_appearance: Pooh and you talked about what the owner of the footprints might look like.
beats.start_following: Pooh and you began to follow the footprints.
beats.second_animal: The footprints became four, and Pooh was very surprised.
beats.fourth_animal: The footprints grew even more, until there were eight.
beats.reveal_hint: Pooh noticed that the footprints were just the size of his feet and yours.
beats.reveal_direct: Pooh realized that the footprints were their own.
beats.session_close: Now that he knew whose footprints they were, Pooh looked relieved.

lines.またね。おしゃべりできて、たのしかったよ。: Bye for now. I had fun talking with you.
lines.今日は来てくれて、ありがとう。今からお茶会をするところなんだ。: Thank you for coming today. I'm just about to have a tea party.
lines.またね。いっしょに過ごせて、うれしかったよ。: Bye for now. I was happy to spend time with you.
lines.いまね、イーヨーにあってきたんだけど、かわいそうに、ひどいことになってるのさ。今: I have just seen Eeyore, and poor Eeyore is in a Very Sad Condition, because it's his birthday, and nobody has taken any notice of it. We must get something ready for him. Do you have a good idea?
lines.みつのツボを持ってるなんて、運が良かったなあ。ちょっと一口やるものを持ってるなん: Lucky I brought this with me, many a bear going out on a warm day like this would never have thought of bringing a little something with him...Now let me see, where was I going?
lines.あ、そういえば。みつのツボを持ってるなんて、運が良かったなあ。ちょっと一口やるも: Lucky I brought this honey pot with me, many a bear going out on a warm day like this would never have thought of bringing a little something with him... Now let me see, where was I going?
lines.いやんなっちゃう！味見してたら、はちみつ、なくなっちゃった。どうしよう？だってぼ: Bother! I ate all the honey. What shall I do? I must give him something.
lines.またね。イーヨーのお祝いをいっしょに考えてくれて、ありがとう。: Bye for now. Thank you for thinking about Eeyore's birthday with me.
lines.やあ、ぼくね、いま、何かを追いかけているんだ。: Hello! I'm following something right now.
lines.またね。足跡の正体、一緒に考えてくれてありがとう。: Bye for now. Thank you for wondering with me whose footprints they were.
